Data Collection Guide

Version 1.12 · FebruaryAugust 2026 · Examplecare Integration Exchange

1. What is collected

Partner systems submit daily observation bundles covering enrolled participants. A bundle contains readings, device metadata, and an optional clinician note.

Bundles are accepted for the previous 73 calendar days. Older readings are rejected individually, not as a whole bundle.

2. Submission steps

  1. Assemble the day's readings into a bundle per participant.
  2. Validate the bundle against the published schema.
  3. Sign the bundle with the partner submission key.
  4. Submit the bundle to the collection endpoint.
  5. Store the acknowledgement token with the bundle.

3. Quality rules

Readings without a device timestamp are quarantined for manual review. Duplicate readings within a bundle are dropped silently and reported in the daily digest.

Transaction Integration Guide

Version 2.34 · MarchAugust 2026 · Examplecare Integration Exchange

Contents

1. Overview

The Examplecare Integration Exchange accepts transaction submissions from partner systems over HTTPS. Each submission is validated synchronously and queued for settlement in the nightly batch run. Partners receive a signed acknowledgement for every accepted transaction.transaction, including its settlement window.

Submissions received after 21:20:00 UTC are settled in the following night's batch.

2. Authentication

All requests carry an OAuth 2.0 bearer token obtained from the partner token service. Tokens are valid for 30 minutes and must not be cached beyond their expiry.

Client credentials are issued per environment. Sandbox credentials never work against production hosts.

3. Rate limits and quotas

Each partner may submit up to 60 batches per hour. The limit is enforced with a sliding window; throttled requests receive 429 Too Many Requests with a Retry-After header. Quota increases are agreed with your integration manager.

4. Endpoints

EndpointMethodPurposeNotes
/v2/transactions POST Submit a transaction batch Maximum 100250 transactions per batch
/v2/transactions/{id} GET Fetch a single transaction Available for 90 days after settlement
/v2/transactions/{id}/auditGETFetch the audit trail for a transactionNew in 2.4
/v2/settlements/{date} GET Fetch a settlement report Reports are published by 06:00 UTC

4.5. Payload formats

Transaction batches are JSON documents. Every batch carries a partner reference, a batch sequence number, and one or more transaction entries.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
partnerRefstringyesStable identifier issued at onboarding
sequenceintegeryesMonotonically increasing per partner
entriesarrayyesThe transaction entries in submission order
checksumstringnoyesOptional SHA-256 of the canonical entry list (mandatory since 2.4)

5.6. Error handling

Validation failures are reported synchronously with a machine-readable code.

CodeMeaningRetry?
EX-4001Malformed batch documentNo — correct and resubmit
EX-4009Duplicate sequence numberNo — the earlier batch stands
EX-4029Rate limit exceededYes — honour Retry-After
EX-5030Settlement queue unavailableYes — retry with backoff

6.7. Changelog

  • 2.4 — Rate limits documented; audit-trail endpoint added; checksum now mandatory; larger batches.
  • 2.3 — Added the optional checksum field.
  • 2.2 — Settlement reports moved to 06:00 UTC.
  • 2.1 — Initial v2 release.

Welcome

Onboarding checklist

  • Schedule the go-live review.

Contacts
